contract.terms_text: Above rates are valid for new bookings only. The rates are valid for all markets. Kindly mention above rates on the booking voucher, failing to do so contracted rates will be applied. All other supplement and terms & conditions are as per the all market contracted rates. The above rates cannot be combined with any other ongoing offers. Kindly note that the management of the hotel has the right to revise or withdraw from the above based on business circumstances with or without prior notice. The rates need to be strictly followed and the hotel reserves the right to reject the reservations which are not aligned with the above rates without any intimation to a particular travel agent. The agents are advised to kindly follow the stop sales which are sent out periodically and accordingly send the reservations. This offer supersedes all the other tactical/flash offers in the market for the said properties. We are continuously auditing our rate parity and incase our reservation is found which is due to a rate leakage then the respective travel agency would pay the differential amount vs the prevailing best available rate or the same will be charged to the guest. In case of high occupancy, the hotel has the right to provide rooms on run of the house basis. Room type/Bed type (King/Twin) will be provided based on availability and not confirmed in advance. For every 7th paid room, 8th room will be provided on 50% of the room rate. For every 15th paid room, 16th room will be provided on 100% FOC basis. Guide room rate will be provided at 50% of the single-room rate for bookings of a minimum of 6 rooms only. In case of high occupancy, the hotel reserves the right to cancel the guide room, and the travel agent will be responsible to find alternative accommodation. Early Check-In/Late Check-out will be provided based on availability and may subject to charge. For any requests exceeding the mentioned maximum number of rooms, please contact our sales team. RATE CONFIDENTIALITY & LIQUIDATED DAMAGES — Confidentiality of B2B Rates: the Travel Agent acknowledges that all B2B rates, net rates and promotional pricing provided by Radisson Hotel Colombo, Radisson Hotel Kandy and Radisson Blu Resort Galle are strictly confidential. The Recipient shall not disclose, publish, or make these rates available to the general public, via online travel agencies (OTAs), public-facing websites, or any unauthorized third party. Breach of Confidentiality: any unauthorized display of these rates in a public forum or searchable online environment shall constitute a material breach of this Agreement and the agreement will be terminated immediately.
contract.voucher_note: Kindly mention above rates on the booking voucher, failing to do so contracted rates will be applied.
contract.notes: "Tier 2" is the rate tier of this sheet (it is in the PDF file name and the e-mail, not inside the document body) — entered as the rate code; the sheet itself prints no rate code. Release date 28 Aug 2026, booking period 01 Sep – 31 Oct 2026, travel period 01 Sep 2026 – 31 Oct 2027 (one continuous table, no separate winter / summer tables). MAXIMUM ROOMS printed per period is on each season ("for any requests exceeding the mentioned maximum number of rooms, please contact our sales team"). "All other supplement and terms & conditions are as per the all market contracted rates" — that base contract is not in this folder, so this plan is not linked to a parent. Valid for all markets, new bookings only. Table 2.0, room type printed "Deluxe Room"; Deluxe Lake View Room and the One-bedroom Lake View Suite are priced as that room + a room supplement per room per night. No All Inclusive rate is offered here. Compulsory gala dinners 24 and 31 Dec 2026 on two bases (on top of the HB rate / on top of the BB rate); nothing is printed for Room Only guests or for children.
